purpose: Teach: 君主/真空/放射能/被爆/高官/元来/堕落/精霊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、君主制の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were writing about the history of monarchy in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle confirmation tone. Steady pacing. The measured voice of a teacher who genuinely remembers her student's work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、真空中の物理現象を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I wrote about physical phenomena in a vacuum.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. Clear and direct. A pause before speaking, gathering his words carefully. Slightly awkward but honest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、放射能被害の長期影響を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were focusing on the long-term effects of radiation exposure in your paper, right?
lines.style: Gentle but attentive. Listening carefully even as she speaks. A slight questioning lilt at the end—genuinely trying to understand. Patient, not correcting him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、被爆地の医療を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, actually—I focused on medical care in areas affected by radiation.
lines.style: Soft correction. A brief hesitation at the start. Respectful but clear. Speaking quietly but with conviction about his actual topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政府高官への取材結果を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper covered the results of interviews with government officials, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged, slightly curious tone. Leaning in slightly with genuine interest. The pace is unhurried—she's giving him space to respond. Warm without being presumptuous.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、元来の伝統文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, mine was actually about traditional culture and its origins.
lines.style: Polite but patient correction. Speaking clearly, a touch slower than usual. Not frustration—just careful to be understood. A small exhale of relief that he can clarify.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、社会の堕落と再生を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And your paper dealt with social decay and renewal, if I remember correctly?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly searching tone. A note of uncertainty underneath—she's testing her memory. Warm but candid about not being entirely sure. Open to being corrected.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、精霊信仰の比較を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I compared different spirit-faith traditions across cultures.
lines.style: Final, gentle correction. Speaking with quiet certainty now. A slight softening at the end—not irritated, just glad to have finally landed on the right answer. Small, genuine relief in his voice.
